headline: Expansion plans to fructify from FY29

highlights: Despite lower headroom for volume growth (due to capacity constraints), gross profit and EBITDA grew by 27%/37% YoY.  FINEORG’s revenue performance has been lumpy since the IPO.

Post earnings revision, maintain BUY with a revised TP of Rs6,700 (earlier Rs6,300) valued at 35x PE on Sep’28E. 2QFY27 performance update: FINEORG’s 2QFY27 revenue growth of 22% YoY was largely pricing-led.
Domestic/Export revenue grew by ~24%/19% YoY, The share of exports revenue stood at 56% vis-à-vis 55% in 2QFY26 and 60% in 1QFY27.
EBITDA growth of ~37% YoY reflects operating leverage and FINEORG’s ability to pass on the RM inflation.
watch: Key Points  FINEORG’s 2QFY27 came ~25% ahead of our and consensus estimates on account of continued contractual re-pricing benefits.
While geopolitical issues, Covid-19 etc. also led to some of the fluctuations, the key reason was supply constraints.
